description:
Maura Murray crashed her car on a snowy New Hampshire road in 2004 — and vanished within 19 minutes. No footprints. No note. No trace. This true crime documentary reopens the file.

On February 9, 2004, 21-year-old nursing student Maura Murray emailed her professors about a family emergency that never happened, packed her dorm room into boxes, withdrew nearly all her money — and drove 140 miles alone into the White Mountains. After her crash on Route 112, a bus driver spoke with her. When police arrived 19 minutes later, she was gone. A search dog lost her scent in the middle of the road.

In this documentary, Dark Case Files walks the full timeline: the false email, the rag in the tailpipe everyone misunderstood, the searches that found no footprints, and the three theories investigators still circle today. Honestly, the 19-minute window is what keeps me up at night. In my opinion, someone out there knows exactly what happened on that road.

What do you think — did Maura walk away, start over, or get into the wrong car? Tell me in the comments.

CHAPTERS:
0:00 The Empty Car on Route 112
0:47 Who Was Maura Murray?
2:02 The Lie and the Packed Room
3:09 The Crash at 7:27 PM
4:58 The Scent That Stopped
6:47 Three Theories
8:08 Still Missing Since 2004
9:02 One Call Could Solve It

Sources: New Hampshire Attorney General's Office case updates; New Hampshire State Police cold case file; contemporary reporting by the Boston Globe and Conway Daily Sun.
